business_summary: Intuit Inc. provides financial management, payments and capital, compliance, and marketing products and services in the United States. The company operates in two segments: Global Business Solutions and Consumer. Its Global Business Solutions segment provides QuickBooks services, which include financial and business management online services, desktop software, payroll solutions, time tracking, merchant payment processing and bill pay solutions, checking accounts, and financing services for small and mid-market businesses; and Mailchimp, a marketing automation and customer relationship management. The Consumer segment provides TurboTax, a do-it-yourself and assisted income tax preparation products and services; Credit Karma, a personal finance solution that provides recommendations for credit card, home, auto, and personal loan, and insurance products; online savings and checking accounts; and access to its credit scores and reports, credit and identity monitoring, credit report dispute, credit building tools, debt pay-down assistance, credit card rewards optimization, and connected account capabilities. This segment also offers ProTax offerings which include Lacerte, ProSeries, and ProFile desktop tax-preparation software products; and ProConnect Tax Online, electronic tax filing service, and bank products and related services. It sells products and services through direct sales channels, multichannel shop-and-buy experiences, online application stores, and partner and other channels. Intuit Inc. has a strategic collaboration with Aprio, LLP to develop AI-powered solutions designed to help identify tax planning opportunities, benchmark business performance, improve financial visibility, and support more informed decision-making across industries, including construction, dental, wealth management, and tax. Intuit Inc. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
business_summary_ko: Intuit Inc.는 미국에서 재무 관리, 결제 및 자본, 규정 준수, 마케팅 제품 및 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 글로벌 비즈니스 솔루션과 소비자라는 두 가지 부문으로 운영됩니다. 글로벌 비즈니스 솔루션 부문은 재무 및 비즈니스 관리 온라인 서비스, 데스크탑 소프트웨어, 급여 솔루션, 시간 추적, 가맹점 지불 처리 및 청구서 지불 솔루션, 당좌예금, 중소기업을 위한 금융 서비스를 포함하는 QuickBooks 서비스를 제공합니다. 마케팅 자동화 및 고객 관계 관리인 Mailchimp가 있습니다. 소비자 부문은 DIY 및 소득세 신고 보조 제품 및 서비스인 TurboTax를 제공합니다. 신용카드, 주택, 자동차, 개인대출, 보험 상품 추천을 제공하는 개인 금융 솔루션인 Credit Karma 온라인 저축 및 당좌 예금 계좌; 신용 점수 및 보고서, 신용 및 신원 모니터링, 신용 보고서 분쟁, 신용 구축 도구, 부채 상환 지원, 신용 카드 보상 최적화 및 연결 계정 기능에 대한 액세스. 이 부문은 Lacerte, ProSeries를 포함한 ProTax 제품도 제공합니다.
